title: Regularization of Hyperbolic Stochastic Partial Differential Equations By Two Fractional Brownian Sheets
summary: In this paper, we establish existence and uniqueness of strong solutions for a stochastic differential equation driven by an additive noise given by the sum of two correlated fractional Brownian sheets with different Hurst parameters. Our analysis relies on techniques from two-parameter fractional calculus and a tailored version of Girsanov's theorem. The main challenge arises from the correlation between the two noises and the technical requirements for applying Girsanov's theorem in this setting.
